igraph_distances_bellman_ford.rationale: Distances automatically selects Bellman-Ford when negative weights require it.

igraph_distances_dijkstra.rationale: Distances automatically selects Dijkstra for non-negative weighted input.

igraph_distances_dijkstra_cutoff.rationale: CutoffDistances automatically selects the weighted cutoff implementation.

igraph_distances_floyd_warshall.rationale: Distances owns distance algorithm selection instead of exposing an implementation-specific method.

igraph_distances_johnson.rationale: Distances owns distance algorithm selection instead of exposing an implementation-specific method.

igraph_largest_independent_vertex_sets.rationale: The public API composes independence-number lookup with explicitly bounded independent-set enumeration.

igraph_largest_weighted_cliques.rationale: The public API composes weighted clique-number lookup with explicitly bounded weighted enumeration.

igraph_expand_path_to_pairs.rationale: Public path APIs return aligned Go-owned vertex and edge sequences directly instead of mutating a low-level integer vector.

igraph_get_shortest_path_bellman_ford.rationale: ShortestPath selects the appropriate weighted algorithm without exposing an implementation-specific method.

igraph_get_shortest_path_dijkstra.rationale: ShortestPath selects the appropriate weighted algorithm without exposing an implementation-specific method.

igraph_get_shortest_paths_bellman_ford.rationale: ShortestPaths selects the appropriate weighted algorithm without exposing an implementation-specific method.

igraph_vertex_path_from_edge_path.rationale: Public path APIs return aligned Go-owned vertex and edge sequences and do not require caller-side path conversion.

igraph_cattribute_has_attr.rationale: Typed graph attribute operations preflight names and types through sorted metadata, so callers do not need a separate untyped existence predicate.

igraph_attribute_combination.rationale: The Go-native immutable policy is assembled internally with checked records instead of exposing the variadic C sentinel API.

igraph_attribute_combination_query.rationale: Call-scoped Go policy values are validated before construction and do not expose a mutable C record query API.

igraph_attribute_combination_remove.rationale: Call-scoped Go policy values are immutable during an operation, so records never need public mutation or removal.

igraph_iea_game.rationale: Milestone 22 will review the experimental independent-edge-assignment model against the existing Erdos-Renyi API before choosing a user-facing, composed, or unsupported disposition.

igraph_rewire_directed_edges.rationale: Milestone 22 plans directed endpoint rewiring through checked direction and probability options and the existing atomic clone-and-swap mutation contract.

igraph_matrix_list_clear.rationale: Mutable C matrix-list clearing remains internal so public callers cannot invalidate nested borrowed storage.

igraph_matrix_list_destroy.rationale: Matrix-list destruction is temporary C cleanup owned by call-scoped adapters, not a public Go lifecycle operation.

igraph_all_minimal_st_separators.rationale: The API materializes every minimal s-t separator in an unbounded vector list and provides no result bound or callback, so a Go-side limit could not prevent exponential C allocation.

igraph_minimum_size_separators.rationale: The API materializes all minimum-size separators, including complete all-mincut subresults, without a pre-materialization bound; interruption does not provide an allocation limit.

igraph_count_multiple_1.rationale: EdgeMultiplicities exposes single- and multi-edge queries through one selector-ordered Go-owned result contract, so the scalar duplicate entry point is not public.

igraph_subcomponent.rationale: Reachability and neighborhood APIs already expose Go-owned vertex sets for directed and undirected traversal, so a second scalar-root surface would duplicate those contracts.

igraph_get_laplacian_sparse.rationale: The package has no coherent immutable Go sparse-matrix representation; Laplacian returns a Go-owned dense Matrix without exposing C sparse storage.

igraph_extended_chordal_ring.rationale: This specialized constructor requires a public integer-matrix contract that the package does not otherwise expose; NewCirculant and NewLCF cover typed chorded-ring construction.

igraph_atlas.rationale: Numeric catalog indexes are opaque, upstream-version-dependent identifiers and do not provide a stable typed Go contract.

igraph_famous.rationale: The string-selected built-in catalog is upstream-version-dependent; explicit constructors provide stable discoverable APIs.

igraph_mycielski_graph.rationale: The upstream API is experimental and too specialized to establish a stable public binding in this construction milestone.

igraph_sparse_adjacency.rationale: The dense Matrix constructor provides the coherent Go-owned boundary; exposing this entry point would require a public sparse storage type and separate ownership contract.

igraph_sparse_weighted_adjacency.rationale: The dense weighted Matrix constructor returns edge-ID-aligned Go-owned weights; exposing this entry point would require a public sparse storage type and separate ownership contract.

igraph_get_adjacency_sparse.rationale: AdjacencyMatrix returns an independently Go-owned dense Matrix; no coherent public sparse storage and ownership boundary exists.

igraph_get_stochastic_sparse.rationale: StochasticMatrix returns an independently Go-owned dense Matrix; no coherent public sparse storage and ownership boundary exists.

igraph_read_graph_ncol.rationale: NCOL requires caller-selected symbolic-name and weight policies and cannot represent isolated vertices; the core reader contract avoids this silent identity and topology loss.

igraph_read_graph_lgl.rationale: LGL requires caller-selected symbolic-name and weight policies and has format-level topology limitations; it is not part of the loss-explicit core reader contract.

igraph_read_graph_pajek.rationale: Pajek has broad format-specific attribute renaming and mixed-network semantics that need a dedicated policy API rather than an implicit core import.

igraph_read_graph_dl.rationale: DL is a specialized legacy matrix/edge-list family whose directedness is supplied outside the file; exposing it requires a separate format-policy API.

igraph_read_graph_graphdb.rationale: GraphDB is a specialized binary graph-database format without the typed attributed interchange contract targeted by the package.

igraph_read_graph_dimacs_flow.rationale: DIMACS flow returns source, target, and capacity outputs in addition to a graph and needs a dedicated flow-problem result contract.

igraph_motifs_randesu_callback.rationale: A public C callback would violate the bounded Go-owned result contract and cross-boundary concurrency model.

igraph_simple_cycles_callback.rationale: The bounded Go-owned collector provides exact truncation without exposing a C callback across the language boundary.

igraph_cliques_callback.rationale: A public C callback would violate the bounded Go-owned result contract.

igraph_layout_umap_3d.rationale: Deferred solver behavior cannot yet be exposed through a stable Go-native contract.

igraph_write_graph_dimacs_flow.rationale: DIMACS flow export is intentionally outside the core graph writer API because it requires explicit source, target, and capacity alignment and belongs in a dedicated validated flow-interchange contract.

igraph_write_graph_dot.rationale: DOT export is intentionally outside the core interchange API because it is visualization-oriented and write-only upstream, with no typed round-trip or loss contract.

igraph_write_graph_leda.rationale: LEDA export is intentionally outside the core interchange API because it selects at most one vertex and one edge attribute and would silently omit the remaining typed metadata.

igraph_write_graph_lgl.rationale: LGL export is intentionally outside the core interchange API because the format cannot faithfully represent directed graphs, loops, multiple edges, isolates by default, or general typed attributes.

igraph_write_graph_ncol.rationale: NCOL export is intentionally outside the core interchange API because it cannot represent isolated vertices and carries only selected vertex names and edge weights.

igraph_write_graph_pajek.rationale: Pajek export is intentionally outside the core interchange API because format-specific attribute selection and naming prevent the package's loss-explicit typed round-trip contract.
